evidence: takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save
note: Dex save for 4d6 fire plus 4d6 radiant damage in a column; half on success.

evidence: Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere
note: Persistent fire sphere: Dex save each turn adjacent; bonus action moves it 30 feet.

evidence: must make another constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns
note: Con save restrains target; three failures petrify it; repeat saves each turn.

evidence: creates a circular, horizontal plane of force
note: Creates a 3-foot force disk holding 500 pounds that follows caster for an hour.

evidence: gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration
note: Touch grants willing creature 60-foot flying speed for up to 10 minutes.

evidence: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog
note: Heavily obscuring fog sphere up to an hour; higher slots widen radius.

evidence: takes 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice)
note: 24-hour ward blocking teleport; chosen creature types take 5d10 on entry.

evidence: any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped
note: Immobile force cage or box traps creatures inside for an hour; Cha save escapes teleport.

evidence: other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target
note: Target gets advantage on attacks, checks and saves; attackers get disadvantage for 8 hours.

evidence: movement is unaffected by difficult terrain
note: Touch ignores difficult terrain, magical slow and paralysis or restraint for an hour.

evidence: If the globe strikes a body of water
note: Con save for 10d6 cold in 60-foot sphere; half on success; may freeze water.

evidence: The target has resistance to nonmagical damage
note: Touch turns creature to mist: flying 10 ft, resistance to nonmagical damage, save advantage.

evidence: draws the creature through it to the nearest unoccupied space
note: Portal to another plane up to 1 minute; can pull a named creature through.

evidence: it must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you
note: Wisdom save or charmed for 30 days; psychic damage when it defies commands.

evidence: protected from decay and can't become undead
note: Preserves a corpse for 10 days, preventing undead and extending raise dead limit.

evidence: transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps
note: Transforms small beasts into giant versions obeying commands; GM runs stats.

evidence: you can replace the number you roll with a 15
note: For an hour, Charisma checks can be replaced with 15; lies read as truthful.

evidence: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence
note: 10-foot barrier blocks spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside.

evidence: choose explosive runes or a spell glyph
note: Hidden trap: triggered Dex save for 5d8 damage, or stores a spell; 1-hour cast.

evidence: Up to ten berries appear in your hand
note: Creates ten berries, each healing 1 HP when eaten, potent for 24 hours.

evidence: A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there
note: 10-foot square of difficult terrain; Dex save or fall prone, repeated on entry.

evidence: becomes invisible until the spell ends
note: Caster or touched creature becomes invisible for up to one minute; concentration.

evidence: You can reduce the target's exhaustion level by one
note: Touch removes one exhaustion level or one chosen curse, charm, petrification, or reduction.

evidence: takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save
note: Spectral guardian damages hostile creatures entering its reach; Dex save for 20 radiant.

evidence: Place your choice of one of the following magical effects
note: Ten-minute ward over 2500 sq ft: fog, locked doors, webs, plus chosen effect.

evidence: roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check
note: Touch grants a d4 bonus to one ability check, once, before it ends.

evidence: the next attack roll made against this target has advantage
note: Ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant; hit gives attackers advantage on next attack.

evidence: must succeed on a strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet
note: Strength save or pushed 15 feet in a 60-foot line; costs double movement toward caster.

evidence: Affected creatures are frightened while in the area
note: Consecrates 60-foot area; chosen effects such as fear, darkness, or silence persist.

evidence: make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube look
note: Makes 150-foot terrain look like other terrain for 24 hours; Investigation to disbelieve.

evidence: its hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour
note: Con save for 14d6 necrotic, half on success; failed save cuts max HP for an hour.

evidence: the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC
note: Doubles speed, +2 AC, extra action each turn; lethargy after it ends.

evidence: regain 70 hit points
note: Restores 70 hit points and ends blindness, deafness, and disease.

evidence: regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting
note: Bonus action: heal chosen creature in range 1d4 plus spellcasting modifier.

evidence: it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks
note: 2d8 fire contact damage, repeatable by bonus action; Con save or drop object or disadvantage.

evidence: the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames
note: Reaction to being damaged: Dex save for 2d10 fire, half on success.

evidence: makes all wisdom saving throws with advantage
note: Ten-minute feast: up to 12 allies gain 2d10 max HP and Wisdom save advantage.

evidence: gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier
note: Touch grants frightened immunity and temp HP each turn; concentration up to a minute.

evidence: fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up
note: Wisdom save or prone and incapacitated; repeats save at turn end or on damage.

evidence: the target can make a new saving throw of Wisdom
note: Wisdom save or paralyzed; repeats save at end of each round, up to 1 minute.
